format: Long 16:9 listen and repeat (lab H25: '100 synonyms in english' cluster)
title: 100 Synonyms in English | Listen and Repeat Practice
description:
100 synonyms in English to listen to and repeat: 100 common words and another word for each one, in a short example sentence. Everyday actions, talking and thinking, describing people, feelings, size and amount, good and bad, time, things and places, work and study, and linking words.

How to practice: you hear a simple word and another word for it, for example "buy" and "purchase". Then you hear the new word in a sentence. Say the sentence out loud in the pause, then listen and say it again.

The 100 synonyms

Everyday actions
buy = purchase, help = assist, start = begin, end = finish, get = receive, need = require, try = attempt, choose = select, fix = repair, answer = reply

Talking and thinking
tell = inform, talk = chat, ask = inquire, think = believe, explain = clarify, shout = yell, understand = comprehend, suggest = recommend, remember = recall, show = demonstrate

Describing people
smart = intelligent, kind = caring, funny = amusing, friendly = welcoming, shy = timid, brave = courageous, calm = relaxed, polite = courteous, rude = impolite, honest = truthful

Feelings
happy = cheerful, sad = unhappy, angry = mad, scared = afraid, worried = anxious, surprised = amazed, tired = sleepy, excited = eager, confused = puzzled, glad = pleased

Size and amount
big = large, small = little, many = numerous, enough = sufficient, whole = entire, empty = vacant, extra = additional, wide = broad, thin = slim, a lot of = plenty of

Good and bad
nice = pleasant, bad = poor, easy = simple, hard = difficult, right = correct, wrong = incorrect, important = significant, cheap = inexpensive, expensive = costly, perfect = flawless

Time
quickly = rapidly, often = frequently, now = currently, soon = shortly, before = previously, later = afterward, sometimes = occasionally, always = constantly, suddenly = abruptly, in the end = eventually

Things and places
job = occupation, trip = journey, gift = present, mistake = error, chance = opportunity, problem = issue, goal = aim, street = road, choice = option, place = location

Work and study
boss = manager, check = verify, make = create, change = modify, improve = enhance, finish = complete, hire = employ, give = provide, organize = arrange, build = construct

Linking words
but = however, also = in addition, so = therefore, because = since, maybe = perhaps, about = approximately, mostly = mainly, really = truly, for example = for instance, in conclusion = to sum up
